calls.statement:
SELECT date_trunc('month', f.sale_date) AS m, f.vat_rate, p.vat_class, count(*) n, sum(f.net_amount) net, sum(f.gross_amount) gross,
 round(sum(f.gross_amount)/sum(f.net_amount),4) ratio,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate))>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mismatch
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id<900 AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH l AS (
 SELECT f.*, s.store_id, p.category FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30')
SELECT date_trunc('month', sale_date) m,
 count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) dist_id, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) dist_rl,
 sum(CASE WHEN store_id=900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) web_lines,
 sum(CASE WHEN store_id=999 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) s999,
 sum(CASE WHEN category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) zz,
 sum(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) staff,
 sum(CASE WHEN quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos,
 min(etl_loaded_at), max(etl_loaded_at), count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) loads
FROM l GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH l AS (
 SELECT f.sale_date, s.store_id, sum(f.net_amount) n FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' GROUP BY 1,2),
r AS (SELECT business_date, store_id, net_sales_before_returns n FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND store_id<900)
SELECT date_trunc('month', coalesce(l.sale_date, r.business_date)) m, sum(l.n) fact, sum(r.n) rpt, count(*) days_store,
 sum(CASE WHEN abs(coalesce(l.n,0)-coalesce(r.n,0))>0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) diffs
FROM l FULL JOIN r ON l.sale_date=r.business_date AND l.store_id=r.store_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('month', f.sale_date) m, f.channel_code, f.channel_id, (s.store_id=900) AS web_store, count(*) n, sum(f.gross_amount) g
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND s.store_id<>999
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

SELECT date_trunc('month', f.sale_date) AS month_start, ROUND(SUM(f.gross_amount),2) AS store_sales_incl_vat_before_returns,
 SUM(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) staff_gross
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
